dev_assets.animated_hint: Animated preview: each character walks and turns through the 4 directions.

character_new.title: New character
character_new.name: Name
character_new.name_hint: 3 to 16 characters: letters, digits, spaces, apostrophes and hyphens.

game.entered: {{name}} ({{className}} lv. {{level}}) enters the world: map {{map}}, position {{x}}, {{y}}.
game.load_error: The game could not be loaded.

hud.hotbar_empty: Empty slot: drag a skill or an item here, or place it from the Skills window (K)

options.keys_help: Keyboard: arrows or WASD to move, Enter/Space/Z to act, Escape/X to cancel and open the menu, F: attack, 1 to 8: shortcuts, Enter: chat. Windows: I bag, C character, K skills, J quests, L friends, G guild, P party, M map, O options. Mouse: click a cell to walk there, a monster or a player to target it.

touch.ios_hint: On iPhone, add the game to your home screen (Share → Add to Home Screen) to play fullscreen.

editor.title: Editor
editor.saved: Map saved and updated in game.
editor.delete_map_confirm: Permanently delete the map "{{name}}" and its history?
editor.unsaved_question: Save the changes of this map before continuing?
editor.speaker: Speaker name
editor.text_placeholder: A blank line separates two messages.
editor.text_help: A blank line separates two messages (4 lines max per message). Codes: \C[n] colour, \I[n] icon, \P player name, \. pause.
editor.json_help: Advanced editing of the whole event (pages, conditions, commands). The visual event editor comes in the next step.
editor.flag_help: Click tiles to change their properties. Passage: ○ passable, × blocking, ☆ drawn above characters. Passage (4 dir.): click near an edge to block it.
editor.only_layer_hint: Show only the chosen layer (when a layer is forced)

resources.title: Resource manager
resources.drop_here: Drop images or sounds here, or click to pick files.
resources.help: Accepted formats: PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG (no scripts), OGG, M4A, MP3, WAV — 15 MB max. Sheets in older layouts (16 px chipsets, 32 px autotiles and tilesets, 16 px sheets) are converted automatically; the original image is kept.

import.title: Import a project / resources
import.help: Choose the ZIP archive of a project folder (containing data/ and img/). Tilesets and maps are added (nothing is overwritten), images and sounds are copied.
import.summary: Import finished: {{maps}} map(s), {{tilesets}} tileset(s), {{images}} image(s), {{sounds}} sound(s).

editor.chest_help: The chest gives its content when the player presses Action in front of it. (Once per character: next step, with self switches.)
editor.spawns_help: Each row places monsters on the passable cells of the given region (0 = the whole map).

warning.folder_ignored: Folder ignored (not used by the engine): {{folder}}
warning.unsupported_command: Event command {{code}} not supported yet ({{count}} occurrence(s)): it will be skipped in game.
warning.plugin_command: Plugin command ({{code}}, {{count}} occurrence(s)): plugins are not supported.
warning.database_file: {{file}} is not imported here: use the database import.
warning.nothing: No recognised content in the archive.
warning.enemy_sprite: Enemy "{{name}}": its battle image is not a character sheet; a default appearance is used.

db.title: Database
db.saved: Saved — usable in game right away.
db.import_confirm: Replace the whole database with the content of this file?
db.discard_question: The changes of this entry are not saved. Discard them?
db.one_per_line: One name per line; the first line is number 0.
db.commands_help: Command list as JSON (the visual editor comes in the next step).
db.switches_help: Name the switches and variables used by your events. "Global": one value for the whole server (world events). Otherwise each character has its own (story progress).
db.instance_help: Switch of each copy of an instanced map (shared by its players)

bag.title: Bag
bag.discard_how_many: How many “{{name}}” to throw away? (1 to {{max}})
bag.discard_confirm: Throw away {{count}} × {{name}}? They will be lost.

notify.battle_no_room: No free room to make the monster appear.
notify.quest_ready: {{name}}: objectives done, go back to the quest giver
notify.chat_help: Commands: /w name message, /r reply, /s map, /all world, /p party, /g guild, /me action, /e 1-10 emote, /friend name, /ignore name, /unignore name, /who
notify.party_kicked: You were removed from the party
notify.guild_kicked: You were removed from the guild
notify.muted: You cannot write in the chat until {{until}} (UTC)
notify.report_sent: Report about {{name}} sent to the moderators. Thank you.

ev.list_help: Double click or Enter: edit (or insert on an empty ◆ row). Delete: remove. Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V: copy, cut, paste.
ev.conditions_help: The last page whose ticked conditions are all met is shown, for each player according to their own progress.
ev.text_codes: Codes: \P player name, \V[n] variable n, \G currency, \C[n] colour, \I[n] icon, \. and \| pauses, \! wait for a key.
ev.choices_help: One choice per line (6 at most). Each choice gets its own branch in the list.
ev.loop_help: The loop commands repeat until "Break loop".
ev.scope_help: A switch or variable is personal (one per character) or global (shared by the whole server) depending on its declaration in the database (Switches and variables tab).
ev.self_help: Self switches belong to this event and to each character: a chest opened by one player stays closed for the others.
ev.step_help: Step 0: go to the next step.
ev.equip_help: The item must be in the player’s bag; the replaced item goes back to it.
ev.recover_help: Restores all the player’s HP and MP.
ev.inn_help: The player pays the price and recovers all HP and MP (refused without enough gold).
ev.later_shop: The shop window comes with the "Shops" step. Until then, the player sees a message.
ev.battle_help: The monster appears next to the player and attacks at once; it is gone for good once defeated. The player fights freely (the event goes on without waiting).
ev.no_se: No sound imported: add files in the resource manager (se folder).
ev.script_help: JavaScript expression evaluated on the server, in a sandbox (v(n), s(n), self('A'), gold(), level(), item(n)).
ev.script_api: Script run on the server in a sandbox limited to 50 ms. Read: v(n), s(n), self('A'), gold(), level(), item(n), player. Write: setV(n, value), setS(n, true/false), setSelf('A', true/false), notify(text).
ev.json_block_help: This command has no dedicated form: edit it as JSON.

quest.title: Quest journal
quest.none_active: No quest in progress. Look for “!” above characters.
quest.follow_hint: Action: follow on screen or stop following
quest.ready_hint: Go back to the quest giver

combat.respawn_in: Back to your respawn point in

skills.none: No skill or usable item yet.
skills.help: Action or drag and drop: place on the hotbar (keys 1 to 8; drag a shortcut off the bar to remove it). Attack: Action facing an enemy, or F.

equip.title: Equipment
equip.nothing: Nothing in the bag for this slot.

shop.nothing_to_sell: You have nothing this merchant buys.

chat.report_prompt: Report {{name}} to the moderators. Reason (insults, cheating, scam…):

trade.title: Trade
trade.help: Each side locks its offer, then each side confirms. Any change cancels the confirmations.

party.title: Party
party.none: You are not in a party. Invite a player by name.

guild.title: Guild
guild.none: You have no guild. Found your own!
guild.name: Guild name

log.motd: {{who}} changed the message of the day

admin_panel.title: Administration
admin_panel.new_password: New password (give it to the player): {{password}}
admin_panel.tools_help: Tools act on a character online (its number is shown on the dashboard); “me” means your own character in game.
admin_panel.backup_help: Downloads a complete, consistent copy of the database (accounts, characters, maps, game data).
admin_panel.restore_help: The backup is checked, then replaces the database at the next server restart (the old one is kept next to it, suffix .before-restore).
admin_panel.restore_scheduled: Backup checked: it will be applied at the next server restart.
admin_panel.resources_help: Custom graphics and sounds are imported in the editor (“Resources” button).
